Hook leg rise above hole centre

scale_note: Real size. Pegs are 5.9 mm (your steel hook's wire is 5.53; the first print at 5.53 was a little loose). The board uses your measured 1/4" holes on 1" centres; its thickness is the listing's 0.155".
notes: v2, after your first print: the pegs go from 5.53 to 5.9 mm (about 0.2 mm per side in your 6.35 mm holes), and the plate now stops just above the hook with its top back edge rounded, so it rocks on like the steel hook instead of the plate catching the board. Check when you reprint: (1) snug now, but still easy to push in? (2) easier to put on? If it's now too tight, the peg size is one number (PegStyle.d in tools/pegboard.py).
